- `_CardFact` loses its tinted icon tiles - the fussiest pixels on the card: a bare 15dp 1px-stroke icon in `boneInk@inkLow`, label in `boneInk@inkMed`, value in `AppTheme.money(labelLarge)` (`goldBright` when highlighted), and a 1dp `ink400@0.25` rule between the two rows.
- The CTA becomes a champagne hairline capsule at the card's foot: full width, 34dp, 1dp `goldBright@0.45`, `AppTheme.smallCaps(labelMedium)` in `goldBright`, 15dp arrow - it is the only action on the card and currently looks like a caption.

**Capped overlay:** the red `Icons.block` goes. `Opacity(0.42)` on the card, then a `PremiumGlassPanel(mode: tinted)` plate with an 18dp `Icons.lock_outline_rounded` in `boneInk@0.55` and the title in `boneInk@0.8` - reserved, not an error the player caused.

`_Pressable` gains a shadow collapse on press (`elevated` -> flat over `Motion.instant`) alongside its existing 0.96 scale, so the card presses into the felt rather than merely shrinking.
components.preservesContract: `onTap: capped ? () {} : () => context.read<GameState>().quickJoin(boot, category)` - the empty closure is requirement 30's client-side refusal and `_Pressable.onTap` is non-nullable, so it stays. `glint: !capped` moves onto the panel unchanged: the sweep is the joinable signal and a capped card must keep suppressing it. `state.config.tables` is still rendered verbatim in server order with no sorting, grouping or filtering. `cappedBody`'s `{cap}` token still goes through `replaceFirst`. `AppTheme.paletteFor` still supplies the identity so the room matches the card that was tapped.

components.name: PrivateTableCard
components.replaces: The stock Material Card at a fixed 320dp - the one rail item that is visibly a different material from its neighbours.
components.spec:
Rebuilt on the same `PremiumGlassPanel(mode: tinted)` as the table cards and given the same square footprint via `AspectRatio(1)`, so the rail has one rhythm at every size (`_Rail.width` 300 and `_PrivateCard`'s 320 both go; the rail's height cap rises from a flat 400 to `(h*0.78).clamp(240, 520)`).

The code field becomes the card's centrepiece: six 34x44 cells (`ink900@0.5`, radius `Radii.xs`, 1dp `goldBright@0.16`, the focused cell at 0.55 with a 2dp `goldBright` caret), each showing one character in `AppTheme.money(titleMedium)` `goldBright`. Implemented as one invisible TextField (still `maxLength: 6`, still `textCapitalization`) with the cells painted from its controller, so nothing about input handling changes. Create is the gold MachinedKey; Join is a ghost MachinedKey, enabled at six characters.
components.preservesContract: `maxLength: 6` still matches the server's room-code length; trimming and upper-casing still happen inside `GameState.joinByCode`, never in the field. `createPrivate()` still sends category 'seen' from this client (the browser sends 'blind') and no category picker is added. The English body line stays as-is - it is one of the three documented untranslated exceptions on this screen.

components.name: GlassCapsule (corner chips) + BuyChipsButton
components.replaces: `_CornerChip`'s flat secondaryContainer/surfaceContainerHighest colour swap, `_Hourglass`, and the buy-chips pill.
components.spec:
`_CornerChip` becomes `PremiumGlassPanel(mode: tinted, radius: Radii.pill, live: enabled)`: `ink900@0.42` fill in BOTH states, with enablement carried by the hairline plus a soft outer glow - `goldBright@0.34` border and `BoxShadow(goldBright@0.16, blur 16, spread -2)` when claimable; `ink400@0.22` border and no glow when not. 'Ready to collect' becomes legible peripherally instead of requiring a colour comparison, and 'not ready' stops looking like a button.

`_Hourglass` is replaced by a 20dp CustomPaint sweep dial: an `ink400@0.4` track ring with a `goldBright` arc showing progress toward the next bonus, and when ready the arc completes and breathes `scale 1 +- 0.05` on the same `Motion.breath` cycle. The two-state idea (turning vs breathing) survives; the 20dp Material hourglass glyph, the cheapest mark in the lobby, does not.

`_MilestoneChip` gains a segmented track under its subtitle - 25 hairline segments, `handsPlayed % 25` filled in `goldBright` - so 'n hands to go' finally shows how close.

`BuyChipsButton` is the ONLY element in the app with a solid gold fill: `LinearGradient([#E4BF52, gold, goldDeep])`, radius `Radii.pill`, 1dp `goldBright` top bevel, `#2A2208` ink, `AppTheme.controlShadow(brightness, elevation: 4, bloom: gold)`. In `compact: true` on the table it is a 40dp circle with the gold chip and a plus, positioned by `Dim` - and it stops competing with the pot because everything around it has become charcoal.
components.preservesContract: The literal strings 'bonus' and 'milestone' passed to `state.claimReward(...)` are untouched - they are the REST path segment. Enablement is still expressed twice: colour AND `onTap: enabled ? onTap : null`. Gating still comes from the server's `r.milestoneAvailable` / `r.bonusReady`, never from `handsToNextMilestone == 0` (which reports 25, not 0, at an exact multiple). Both chips still return `SizedBox.shrink()` when `user?.rewards` is null, so no claim can fire against unknown reward state. `formatCountdown(r.untilBonus)` still ticks off the 1s notifier.

components.name: RewardCelebration
components.replaces: Its scrim, panel and burst.
components.spec:
Scrim `ink900@0.68` under a full-screen `BackdropFilter(sigma: 10)` - the one place a whole-screen blur is spent, with `GlassBudget` dropping to 0 beneath it so nothing else blurs simultaneously. Behind the panel, a slow radial gold bloom (`RadialGradient([gold@0.18, transparent])`, radius 0.35 to 0.55 over 900ms `easeOutCubic`).

Panel becomes `PremiumGlassPanel(mode: blurred, sigma: 24, radius: Radii.xxl, live: true)` with padding scaled by `Dim.scale(w)` - today's fixed 38/30/38/26 makes it the tallest fixed block on a 360dp-tall landscape phone. `SpinningChip(colour: gold, size: (h*0.16).clamp(44, 68))`. Title `titleMedium` w600. The amount, which is the hero, in `AppTheme.money(headlineMedium)` `goldBright` with a 12dp `gold@0.30` glow. Blurb `bodyMedium` `boneInk@inkMed`. Dismiss is the gold MachinedKey.
components.preservesContract: `_in` stays built in `initState`, deliberately not a lazy `late final` field initialiser - `build` returns `SizedBox.shrink()` almost always, so a lazy controller would first be constructed inside `dispose()` on a deactivated element (the same bug already fixed in seat_pod's `_Blink`). `_shownFor` still compares `won.amount`. `dismissReward()` remains the only way to clear it - no timeout is added, it stays blocking, and the rail stays covered and untappable behind it, because it is the receipt for an irreversible chip grant.

components.name: NoticeToast
components.replaces: The default SnackBar with its hardcoded `width: 420`.
components.spec: `SnackBar(behavior: floating, backgroundColor: transparent, elevation: 0, width: Dim.toastW(w), content: PremiumGlassPanel(mode: tinted, radius: Radii.md))`. Fill `ink900@0.82`, 1dp `goldBright@0.16`, and a 3dp leading vertical rule carrying severity: `goldBright` for a grant (welcome chips, reward, rename saved), `#FF6B5A` for a refusal or a kick, `ink400` for neutral. Text `bodyMedium` `boneInk@0.92` with a 16dp leading glyph. Duration and dismissal unchanged.
components.preservesContract: Still driven by `state.notice` via `context.select` and cleared through `clearNotice()`. Crucially, `chip_store.dart:379`'s direct `state.notice = ...` write - which reaches the screen only because `Navigator.pop` rebuilds, with no `notifyListeners` - still surfaces, because the host is not made to depend on the notifier firing.

components.name: ResumeVeil + ScreenTransition
components.replaces: The opaque `Material(color: scheme.surface)` veil, and `_Root`'s instant `switch (screen)` swap.
components.spec:
**Veil:** `Positioned.fill > BackdropFilter(sigma: 18) > ColoredBox(ink900@0.55)` with a 56dp gold SpinningChip and the line in `AppTheme.smallCaps(titleSmall)` at `boneInk@0.85`. The table now resolves out of the lobby instead of appearing from behind a slab. `GlassBudget` drops to 0 beneath it.

**Transition:** the screen switch is wrapped in `AnimatedSwitcher(duration: Motion.slow, switchInCurve: Motion.emphasized)` keyed on the `Screen` enum, transitioning with fade plus a 0.985-to-1.0 scale over the shared `ink800` ground, so lobby-to-table never flashes a bright frame. A custom `layoutBuilder` stacks the outgoing child beneath rather than centring it, so nothing jumps mid-transition.

`_Root` also wraps its subtree in `MediaQuery.withClampedTextScaling(minScaleFactor: 0.9, maxScaleFactor: 1.25)` - the app's single answer to OS font scaling, which today has none and is only ever rescued by FittedBoxes shrinking type.
components.preservesContract: `_BackGuard` still walks `[tableScaffold, lobbyScaffold]` and closes an open drawer/endDrawer before asking the leave or quit question - the AnimatedSwitcher sits INSIDE it and adds no Navigator. The veil is still gated on `resuming && screen != Screen.splash`; `_armSeatCheck()` and the 1800ms dead-seat detection are untouched (the veil is a state machine that merely looks like a spinner). `main()` still calls `runApp` first with `state.start()` unawaited, `minSplash` is still honoured, and the splash is still replaced only `if (screen == Screen.splash)` so an early table snapshot wins that race.

components.name: SplashScreen + LoginCard
components.replaces: The flat splash ground, and the login stock Card.
components.spec:
**Splash:** the same `assets/app_icon.svg` at the same clamp, over the TableGround's emerald-to-charcoal radial, with one champagne sweep crossing the mark during the 650ms fade - the first frame states the palette. Studio line in `AppTheme.smallCaps(labelMedium)` at tracking 1.8 in `boneInk@inkLow`.

**Login:** Card becomes `PremiumGlassPanel(mode: blurred, sigma: 20, radius: Radii.xxl)`, max width 620. The RichText title keeps its two-tone treatment with 'Teen Patti' in `goldBright`. The name field becomes the FrostedField. Guest is the gold MachinedKey. The two permanently-disabled provider buttons come off the surface and are replaced by one quiet line in `AppTheme.smallCaps(labelSmall)` `boneInk@inkLow`, so the entry screen stops advertising controls that cannot work. Version footnote in `AppTheme.money(labelSmall)` at `boneInk@0.40`.
components.preservesContract: Splash is still held for at least `GameState.minSplash`. Login still calls `state.loginAsGuest(name)`, still `maxLength: 24`, still surfaces `state.loginError`, still reads `state.busy`. Removing the two dead buttons removes no callback (`onPressed` was already null) and deletes no string key - the existing `guestNoSocial` copy is reused for the replacement line, so no new key is needed in the five language maps.

components.name: FrostedField
components.file: lib/theme/app_theme.dart (InputDecorationTheme) - reaches the settings name field, the private code entry and the chat composer
components.replaces: The stock filled InputDecorator at radius 16.
components.spec:
One `InputDecorationTheme`: `filled: true`, `fillColor: ink900@0.45`, radius `Radii.md`, enabled border 1dp `ink400@0.35`, focused 1.4dp `goldBright@0.55` with no glow, error 1.4dp `#FF6B5A@0.6`. Labels and hints `boneInk@inkLow`; input text `boneInk@0.94`. Prefix and suffix icons `boneInk@inkLow`, rising to `goldBright` on focus.

One functional addition, chat composer only: a live counter appearing past 120 characters in `AppTheme.money(labelSmall)` `boneInk@inkLow`, turning `amber` past 140 - surfacing the silent server truncation (the field allows 200, `CHAT_MAX_LENGTH` is 140). **The field's `maxLength: 200` is NOT changed**, so nothing about what is sent moves.
components.preservesContract: `_SettingsDrawerState._save` still shows the server's own message through `_nameError`, and no client-side validator or inputFormatter is added - the server's NAME_PATTERN allows `\p{M}` for Indic vowel signs and a client validator would reject legitimate names. `maxLength: 24` still mirrors DISPLAY_NAME_MAX; `counterText: ''` stays suppressed everywhere it is suppressed today.

components.name: ChipStoreShelf
components.replaces: The gold PremiumSurface panel, the five ribbon colours, the emoji flair and the fixed shelf metrics.
components.spec:
The panel becomes `PremiumGlassPanel(mode: blurred, sigma: 24, radius: Radii.xxl)` over `ink900@0.72`, with `GlassBudget` 0 beneath. Pack cards become `PremiumGlassPanel(mode: tinted, radius: Radii.lg)` - there are nine of them - sized `Dim.packW(w)` on a shelf of `(h*0.55).clamp(180, 260)` instead of flat 168/206.

The emoji and the five ribbon colours go. One tier marker survives: a single gold ribbon on the featured pack, `gold` fill with `#2A2208` `AppTheme.smallCaps` text, keeping its ShaderMask shimmer at `Motion.sweep`. The featured halo drops from a breathing coloured glow to a static `BoxShadow(gold@0.14, blur 22, spread -4)`. Price in `AppTheme.money(titleSmall)` `goldBright`; chip count in `AppTheme.money(headlineSmall)` `boneInk`. A store that whispers converts better than one that flashes.
components.preservesContract: `LivelyChipStack`'s `colours.length` is still layout (it sets the card height), so the existing `List.generate(3 + index ~/ 4, ...)` is left alone and the stack is not re-keyed. `state.notice = t.storeNotLive` still fires from the same line. `_deliverPurchase` is untouched - nothing in the UI may short-circuit it or return true on a path that did not credit, and `purchasePending` remains the hook for any future spinner rather than a second flag.

components.name: RulesSheet
components.replaces: The surface@0.86 dialog with its primary@0.45 border and 46dp example cards.
components.spec: `PremiumGlassPanel(mode: blurred, sigma: 22, radius: Radii.xxl)` over `ink900@0.62`. The numbered CircleAvatars become rank numerals in `AppTheme.money(titleMedium)` `goldBright@0.75`, right-aligned in a 28dp gutter, with a 1dp `ink400@0.25` rule between rows. Example cards go from a fixed 46dp to `Dim.ruleCardH(h)`. The chevron becomes a 1dp `goldBright@0.35` caret. Content and ordering untouched - the content is already right; the container was the weak part.
components.preservesContract: Still opened by `showRules(context)` from its three call sites, still after `Navigator.pop(context)` has closed the drawer first (reversing that order pops the dialog instead of the drawer).

components.name: PicturePickerSheet
components.replaces: The stock M3 modal bottom sheet and its 3dp green selection ring.
components.spec: `showModalBottomSheet(backgroundColor: transparent, barrierColor: ink900@0.55, isScrollControlled: true)` wrapping `PremiumGlassPanel(mode: blurred, sigma: 22, radius: Radii.xxl top corners)` with a hand-drawn 4x36 `goldBright@0.25` drag handle. The avatar strip sits on a felt band - `feltMid@0.35` with the weave gradients at half strength - so the choices read as sitting on the table rather than on a white sheet. Strip height `Dim.pickerH(h)` with avatar radius `pickerH*0.36` (today: a fixed 88 and 32, which can overflow a short landscape phone). Selection uses AvatarRing's double ring: 2.5dp `goldBright` with a 2dp `ink800` gap inside, still animated over `Motion.base`.
components.preservesContract: `chooseAvatar(picture.id)` and `chooseAvatar(null)` stay two distinct server calls; the 'use social picture' button is still shown-but-disabled (never hidden) for guests and accounts with no `providerAvatarUrl`. URLs still resolve through `state.absoluteUrl` for the server-relative `/profiles/*.svg` paths.
